batch: prune20; baseline is turn-start worktree, not HEAD
changes: A10: readIndex now awaits lstat/readFile; missing index returns an empty list but invalid JSON/schema, symbolic links and non-ENOENT IO failures propagate. JSON parsing remains on the main thread.

A10: findFileMeta no longer reads archive files. Only list/download metadata/info/ingest boundaries await the archive and merge provenance where needed; post-await ownership guards continue using synchronous current in-memory metadata, preventing archive fallback from recreating metadata during those guards.

A10: async read boundaries revalidate organization membership and identity/role after await. Serialized mutation, fsync, atomic rename, source checks and tombstones remain. Mutations recheck authorization after the new read; registration checks source identity again after reading the index.

A10: full listing filters against one directory name set instead of per-file exists checks. Removes the old caller-supplied directory-set option that has no production consumer after async boundary convergence. Route listing still enumerates the directory freshly after awaiting to avoid using a stale list.

A11: shared terminal task construction/state update for completion/failure/cancellation. Unverified completion still fails, background scope guard retained, notifications remain success/warning/none respectively. Does not consolidate the separate queue/history/event arrays in this batch.

A11: PersonalityEditor loading and empty states share markup, preserving both messages. Remove six unused language helper functions and hook-only references; rendering still subscribes to locale and live date formatting retained. Avatar generation depends on the actual onSelectPet callback.
